# awdesk

> Aither World Desk -- the desktop body of AitherOS Online: tray, avatars, decision cards, the Living Desktop as an overlay.

Every surface an agent has on a laptop lives in a browser tab that can be closed, minimized or forgotten. The desk is the one that stays: an always-on presence that can interrupt you with a decision card, embody an agent as an avatar, and hold the Living Desktop over your real desktop.

## Install

```
see the repo -- Electron app (npm install && npx electron .)
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Run it, and the next decision card an agent raises pops on your desktop instead of scrolling past in a log.

## Composes with

- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awsh](https://aitherium.github.io/awsh/) — Your terminal answers you -- type a question where a command would go.
- [awvoice](https://aitherium.github.io/awvoice/) — Hear and speak — transcribe audio, synthesize a voice.
- [awvision](https://aitherium.github.io/awvision/) — See an image — describe it, ask it a question, compare two.
- [awsprite](https://aitherium.github.io/awsprite/) — Hatch a companion that grows only from what you teach it, then take it home.
- [awavatar](https://aitherium.github.io/awavatar/) — One character spec in, a rigged, animated, multi-style avatar pack out.
- [AitherConnect](https://aitherium.github.io/AitherConnect/) — Browser extension — federated AI search, page context, and the Living OS overlay.
- [awdaemons](https://aitherium.github.io/awdaemons/) — The AitherOS daemons as one file — no Python, no signing, no install.
- [awsettings](https://aitherium.github.io/awsettings/) — Your agent's permissions and config, following you to the next machine.

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awdesk.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.
